codeReview.summary: All 19 #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] annotations have been replaced with parameter structs across 4 crates (katla_gfx, katla_app, katla_math, katla_ui). 12 parameter structs were introduced. The refactoring is clean, all call sites updated, zero clippy warnings, all tests pass. One minor UI bug introduced (duplicate label in preferences), and one scope concern with debug_output.txt and unrelated deletions.

issues.description: Duplicate ui.label_auto_colored("Color Theme", theme.text_secondary) call after extracting AppearanceTabParams. The build_appearance_tab function calls set_cursor then renders 'Color Theme' label + spacing(20), then immediately renders 'Color Theme' label + spacing(20) again. This is a visual bug causing the 'Color Theme' label to appear twice with a 20px gap between them in the appearance preferences tab.
debug_output.txt (309 lines of headless validation output from 2026-04-06) was committed. This is a runtime artifact that should not be in version control. It should be added to .gitignore.

The entire timing.rs file (292 lines including TimestampQuery struct) was deleted. While it was marked #[allow(dead_code)], this is unrelated to the too-many-arguments audit and constitutes scope creep. If the dead code removal was intentional, it should have been part of a separate cleanup feature.

set_hdr_texture_index() method was removed (43 lines). The tonemapping and wallhack overlay shaders were refactored to read from frame_data.tonemap/frame_data.overlay instead of objects[0].base_color. This is a semantic shader change beyond the scope of parameter struct refactoring. The change is architecturally sound (post-processing params belong in frame uniforms, not object[0] abuse), but it changes GPU buffer layout and shader contracts.
Test assertion changed from emit_rate == 50.0 (default) to emit_rate == 0.0 (destroyed). This corrects a previously wrong test expectation but is unrelated to the too-many-arguments audit.

Three new editor handler methods were extracted (handle_editor_mouse_press, handle_editor_mouse_release, handle_editor_keyboard_shortcuts, handle_editor_gizmo_shortcuts). While these consolidate cfg(editor) blocks and reduce annotation count, they are unrelated to parameter struct refactoring. The consolidation is a positive change but constitutes scope creep from the feature description.

16 new widget default size fields were added to UiStyle along with a WidgetDefaults struct and DEFAULTS constant. This is from the 'reduce-cfg-editor-and-widget-sizes' feature, not the too-many-arguments audit. These changes are intermingled in the same commit.

sharedStateObservations.observation: debug_output.txt should be added to .gitignore. Runtime artifacts from headless validation (cargo run -- -s) are being committed to the repo.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker intermixed changes from multiple features into a single commit. The commit includes changes from 'reduce-cfg-editor-and-widget-sizes' (widget default sizes in UiStyle), dead code cleanup (timing.rs removal), shader refactoring (tonemap/overlay from objects[0] to frame_data), and the actual too-many-arguments parameter struct work. AGENTS.md says 'No hybrid implementations' but that's about code patterns, not commits. Still, one-logical-change-per-commit from the git conventions would have been better.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Commit fbd807c touches 52 files across multiple logical changes unrelated to parameter struct refactoring

sharedStateObservations.observation: The Mat3 internal storage layout is row-major (each Vec3 in the Mat3 array is a row, not a column), which is unusual for graphics code that typically uses column-major. The worker correctly renamed from_elements to from_rows to reflect this. This quirk should be documented in katla_math AGENTS.md or architecture.md.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: katla_math/src/mat3.rs: Mat3([row0, row1, row2]) - from_elements originally stored rows as columns, causing confusion. Worker renamed to from_rows to be explicit about the layout.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The post-processing parameter migration (tonemap/overlay/compositing from objects[0].base_color abuse to proper frame uniform fields) is a significant shader contract change. The fullscreen-shader-patterns.md and compositing-shader.md in .factory/library/ may need updating to reflect that fullscreen shaders should now use frame_data.tonemap/overlay instead of objects[0].
sharedStateObservations.evidence: resources/shaders/tonemapping.wgsl and wallhack_overlay.wgsl changed from reading objects[0].base_color to reading frame_data.tonemap/overlay. set_hdr_texture_index() removed from material_api.rs.

summary: The core task is complete: all 19 #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] annotations are replaced with 12 well-structured parameter structs, zero clippy warnings remain, and all tests pass. However, the commit includes significant scope creep beyond parameter struct refactoring: shader contract changes (moving post-processing params from objects[0] to frame_data), dead code removal (timing.rs), widget default size additions (from another feature), and editor handler method extraction. A minor UI bug was introduced (duplicate 'Color Theme' label in preferences). These issues are non-blocking for the feature's verification criteria but should be addressed separately.
